report.summary: Artifacts repo.log lookups in artifactHeadSha and branchTips now pass bare branch names instead of refs/heads/<branch>. This matches the binding's real contract in worker-runtime.d.ts (`opts.ref Branch, tag, or commit ID`) and the browse handler, which already passes bare refs. The test fakes no longer strip refs/heads/, so the tests now check the bare form, and the call-order assertion matches. The e2e regex change suits Node 24 (container base node:24-trixie-slim), where node --test prints spec-reporter summaries (`ℹ fail 0`) even when piped; the new patterns match both TAP and spec output. Nothing blocking. One open risk: a tag with the same name as a branch, or a 40-hex branch name, could resolve to something other than the branch, because the binding's lookup order is not documented. I could not run the worker suite: bun x fetched vitest 5.0.4 instead of the pinned version, and the repo's own binary was not reachable.

findings.text: A bare branch name passed as ref is resolved by the binding as a branch, tag or commit ID. If a tag has the same name as a branch, or a branch name is 40 hex characters (BRANCH_NAME allows both), log may return the tag's or that commit's hash instead of the branch tip. The binding does not document its lookup order. Plain git checks refs/tags before refs/heads. A live Artifacts test with a tag and a branch of the same name would confirm. Not blocking: the change follows the documented contract, and the old refs/heads/ form evidently did not resolve on the real binding (the e2e fix shows this).

evidence.quote: return (await repo.log({ ref: branch, limit: 1 }))[0]?.hash ?? null;
evidence.why: The ref is not namespaced to refs/heads, so if names collide it may resolve to a tag or a commit ID depending on the binding's undocumented lookup order.

checked.risk: Real contracts (Artifacts binding log ref semantics vs test fakes)
Failure paths (unresolved ref -> empty array -> null/NOT_FOUND, SHA validation retained)
Security / input validation before binding calls (validateArtifactBranch, BRANCH_NAME)
Idempotency and state (callers of artifactHeadSha unchanged)
Build/runtime environment (Node version and node --test reporter output for e2e regex)
Tests (fakes now exact-match bare refs, assertions observable, no sleeps added)
Spec conformance (09 Git Forge ref rules, refs/heads exposure)
